title: Eric Davis helped write a book for Bigelow during AAWSAP

tellings.quote: During OAP, it turns out basically Davis was helping write that book at the time for BB.

plain: During AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of UFOs and related strange phenomena that began in 2008, the physicist Eric Davis was helping write a book for the businessman Robert Bigelow. That is what Jack says: he is Michels' co-host and technical correspondent, who goes only by that pseudonym and says he works in defense and aerospace. He says it "turns out" Davis was writing "that book" at the time, which would tie a government study to a private book project.
